psychology: First-impression / aesthetic-usability (Lindgaard 50ms; Kurosu & Kashimura) — the drenched-black stage with a single bright CTA is a clean thesis statement that buys forgiveness before any app is seen
Von Restorff effect — the lone white capsule CTA on pure black is the one different thing, so it is pre-attentively unmissable
Hick's Law — exactly one action and zero competing choices on the hero, minimizing decision latency at the download prompt
Jakob's Law — the Apple-glyph 'Download for free' pill matches the trained macOS-download convention, so the affordance needs no learning
Fogg B=MAP (reduction) — 'No sign-up required · Free to try' strips ability-cost friction exactly at the prompt, raising the odds motivation converts to action
